items.title: Bernard Purdie interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: Sam “the Man” Taylor, David Newman, Marshall Royal. I mean all these guys were all legends to me.

ctx.x: Who were the people in the key positions, the bass player, the guitar and even like the tenor sax soloists that you liked to see on the date?
King Curtis was the tenor sax soloist. Sam “the Man” Taylor, David Newman, Marshall Royal. I mean all these guys were all legends to me. And guitar players was Mickey © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

Baker, Eric Gale, Hugh McCracken, David Spinozza, Vinnie Bell, Wally Richardson. I mean these guitar — and Bucky Pizzarelli. I mean for me I could not have ever asked for anybody any better than those musicians. I mean there were hundreds that you could go along with the program with and have them on the date and it would automatically turn out. But you had to know who you put together.
